proceedings.supporting_quote: By a decision dated 15 March 2001, the Banking Regulation and Supervision Board... resolved to transfer the management and control of İktisat Bankası T.A.Ş... to the Savings Deposit Insurance Fund
on 14 September 2001, the Fund resolved to recover 726,122,000 Turkish liras from the former shareholders
On 19 July 2007, the Fund decided to establish two economic and commercial units: one for Viva TV and the other for Radio Viva.
On 29 August 2007, the Fund resolved to offer both Viva TV and Radio Viva for sale together in a single tendering process
On 3 April 2008, the Fund concluded that the Erol Aksoy Group had failed to fulfil several commitments... the Fund decided to rely on its provisions concerning default
On 18 September 2008, the Fund further resolved to transfer the management and control of all companies within the Erol Aksoy Group to itself
On 9 July 2009, the Fund decided to merge the two economic and commercial units, thereby creating the Viva TV-Radio Viva Economic and Commercial Unit
On 5 November 2009, the Fund resolved to offer Viva TV-Radio Viva for sale
On 13 January 2011, the Fund decided to offer Viva TV-Radio Viva for sale again
on 3 May 2012, the Fund approved the award of Viva TV-Radio Viva to company A.
